bagPolicy.summary: Large backpacks and luggage are not accepted. Small bags and pouches are allowed; self-service cloakrooms are available inside, and exterior storage is available for prohibited items.
bagPolicy.note: Event productions can impose additional restrictions; check the event page.

parking.note: LDLC Arena has car, motorcycle, and bicycle parking. Paid car/motorcycle parking must be reserved online through the event page; bicycle parking is available near the arena.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare pickup zone was not confirmed in the current LDLC Arena FAQ. Use the event-specific access instructions and signed pickup/drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The LDLC Arena offers a variety of food options with 75% of the menu made in-house using fresh ingredients. Visitors can enjoy burgers, tenders, hot-dogs, fries, sandwiches, and more. Additionally, there are special carts for crêpes and Haribo treats in the main hall.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: LDLC Arena publishes accessible arrival and in-venue guidance, including elevators for level 2 and accommodation for medical equipment and guide/service dogs. Contact the venue in advance for event-specific needs.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in LDLC Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at LDLC Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Door-opening times and access instructions are event-specific. Check the dedicated event page shortly before arrival for the current opening time and entrance information.
